The '''Temple of Korman Lao''' was a megastructure the size of an entire [[Planet/Legends|world]], constructed by the fanatical [[Kanzer Exiles]] in honor of their leader, [[Korman Lao]], near the [[Valtaullu Rift/Legends|Valtaullu Rift]]<ref name="UR" /> deep within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="SM" /> The Kanzer Exiles claimed that they had been able to mentally enslave many [[Sentience/Legends|sentient minds]] simultaneously,<ref name="BS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> a power they had likely used while building the temple. However, after generations, the once-imposing structure had shattered, leaving behind an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] of rubbles.<ref name="SM" />

During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] adept [[Cronal]] explored the Unknown Regions, hoping to uncover knowledge that would grant him unlimited power. Within the [[Gunninga Gap/Legends|Gunninga Gap]], Cronal discovered scraps of the [[Taurannik Codex]], and the arcane hints from that forbidden tome led him to the ruins of Lao’s temple within the Valtaullu Rift. The lore contained in the temple fragments gave him the knowledge he needed to capture the corrupt spirit essence of the ancient Sith [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="SM" />
